card.name: Inside romanized Chinese names
card.fires_on: Syllables partway through pinyin spellings of Chinese herb names, formula names and personal names, such as the uo in huo, hi in zhi, or ui in Teng-hui.

modes.label: Herbal formula names
modes.description: Pinyin syllables inside Chinese herbal formula or herb names in parentheses.
modes.example: Notopterygium & tuhuo combination (qiang h<<uo>> sheng shi tang) treats headache

modes.label: Chinese person and movement names
modes.description: Pinyin syllables inside Chinese personal names or historical terms in general web text.
modes.example: Montagnon, P., & Dickie, M. (1999, March 1). Lee Teng-h<<ui>>: The unrepentant leader.
